items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1960-09-16
items.q: I heard the Claiborne Williams band. ... My daddy named L.M. Summers, or Leon Summers. Claiborne Williams. I see where else they're. I just remember some of those fellas named me.

ctx.x: That was 1980. I remember you were saying that you did hear the Claiborne Williams band.
Well I heard the Claiborne Williams band.
What kind of a band was that Eddie?

items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1963-11-11
items.q: Well, he played with Claiborne Williams.

ctx.x: Uh huh. What was it, brass bass or string bass? Uh, string bass. Uh huh. Do you remember any of the bands he played with?
Well, he played with Claiborne Williams. Uh huh. He played with the Grandison Tango. Uh huh. And he played with the, uh, Gray Stevenson Band from Port Island, Louisiana. Uh huh.
Uh huh. Uh huh. Well, when did you, uh, come to New Orleans?
